versos.texto_bv: Amarre as argolas do peitoral às argolas do éfode com um cordão azul, para que o peitoral fique sobre a faixa trabalhada do éfode e não se afaste dele.
versos.traducao_literal: E amarrarão o peitoral, das argolas dele às argolas do éfode, com um cordão de azul-celeste, para estar sobre a faixa do éfode; e não será deslocado o peitoral de sobre o éfode.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “Amarre” (imperativo 2ª sg., dirigido a Moisés) muda o sujeito da ação: o hebraico tem וְיִרְכְּסוּ, 3ª pessoa do plural (“e amarrarão”, os artesãos), como em 28.5–6 (“tomarão”, “farão”). — evidência: Morfologia pinada HVqi3mp (lemma 7405); traducao_literal: “E amarrarão o peitoral”; KJV: “And they shall bind the breastplate”. Corrigir a pessoa verbal alteraria o sentido (quem executa), portanto o texto permanece idêntico.

kjv.texto: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

vizinhos.27: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
vizinhos.29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.

web.texto: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

vizinhos.27: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
vizinhos.29: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.
